remarks: Discover the perfect blend of comfort and convenience in this 1bed 1bath condo located in the vibrant heart of downtown Stamford. This spacious unit boasts modern amenities including a breakfast bar, and a generously sized living room, large bedroom with walk-in dressing room, in-unit laundry, and multiple additional closets for ample storage. Enjoy expansive city views from your windows and take advantage of both garage and off-street parking. You'll love the prime location, just steps away from Mill River Park, a variety of downtown restaurants, and shopping destinations. Commuting is a breeze with easy access to I-95, Metro-North, and major bus lines. Plus, the building has a community rooftop with panoramic views of Long Island Sound-perfect for relaxing after a long day. This condo is truly a commuter's dream and a must-see!
